Duties of Recorder of Deeds
Recording Land Instruments
Most recording can be done by mail or delivered in person. When mailing,
please include a telephone number, in case we have questions when document
is received.
Missouri statute calls for specific margins, types of legal description,
font size, notarization & more for documents being recorded. If you are
unsure if your document meets those requirements, please email a copy of the
document to us, prior to mailing or delivering, at
county.recorder@bentoncomo.com to avoid having document rejected when
presented.
E-recording
is available, BUT ONLY for businesses who contract for that type of service.
For more e-recording info, contact our software provider, I-County at (816)
295-1540 or other e-recording provider.
Issuing of Marriage Licenses
Hours for marriage license applications are 8:00-11:30 am and 1:00-4:00 pm. No appointment is necessary. BOTH parties have to appear together with photo IDs for the application process. Payment of $62 ($53 for license plus $9 for 1 certified copy after license is returned to be recorded) is due at time of application. Payment must be by cash or debit/credit card (NO checks). Use of debit/credit card incurs an additional $2 fee collected and kept by the credit card processor.
Issuing of other certified copies of marriage licenses for use in proving
marriage to Department of Motor Vehicles, Social Security or other agencies
We can only issue certified copies of licenses obtained in Benton County.
If you were married here, but applied for your license in another Missouri
county, you will need to contact that county for any copies you need. If you
obtained your marriage license in Benton County, but do not have a certified
copy or need an additional copy, those can be picked up in our office or
mailed to you. Certified copies are $9.00 each.
Recording Military Discharge Records (DD214)
This is a free service and any copies of the recorded instrument are also free.
Searches of our land records index
are available at https://bentonmo.icounty.com/
There you can set up a free account as a New User that enables you to search for items recorded
as far back as January 1962 up to present. You are only able to see the index (Grantors, grantees, abbreviated legal description, date, etc) – NOT the actual deed itself.
Copies of documents can be ordered online or directly from us by phone or
email. Companies wishing to buy a monthly subscription to obtain images must
contact I-County at (816) 295-1540.
Our land records go back to the 1830’s but are currently only in
searchable digital form to 01/1962 (except for a few scanned before that time). Prior to 1962, items are in books and on microfilm in our office. For a copy of the actual instrument
before 01/1962, you would need to contact us by phone or email. Copies are $1 per page.
Deedwatch Property Fraud Alerts
For our FREE property fraud alert service, handled by our software
provider (NOT by a third-party company), visit
www.Deedwatch.com & choose "Benton
County, Missouri" from the drop-down menu. Then, enter your preferred email
address & complete the registration from the email you receive. You will
then be able to receive email alerts if any document is recorded with your
name on it.
